newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia c/account deficit widens in November.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia c/account deficit widens in November.

text.p: Australia's seasonally-adjusted current account deficit widened to A$1.923 billion in November from October's deficit of A$1.807 billion (revised from A$1.788 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compares with a seasonally adjusted deficit of A$2.333 billion in November 1995.
The unadjusted November deficit was A$1.843 billion against A$2.386 billion in October, compared with a deficit of A$2.789 billion in November 1995.
Economists had on average forecast a seasonally adjusted November current account deficit of about A$1.75 billion.

The Bureau said exports fell 5.0 percent in November, seasonally adjusted, with rural exports falling two percent and non-rural exports falling six percent.
